meta.name: convertkit-automation
meta.description: Automate ConvertKit (Kit) tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): manage subscribers, tags, broadcasts, and broadcast stats. Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动管理邮件订阅者、标签和广播
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用 ConvertKit 做邮件自动化营销
copy.tagline_en: Automate ConvertKit subscriber, tag, and broadcast management
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use ConvertKit for email marketing automation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以管理 ConvertKit（Kit）中的订阅者、标签、邮件广播及广播统计。它会先搜索当前可用的工具，然后执行查询、添加标签、取消订阅、查看或删除广播等操作。
howto.when: 当你要求查看或管理 ConvertKit 订阅者、标签、广播时触发。例如：查找订阅者、给某人打标签、取消订阅、列出或删除广播。

say.text: 帮我查一下邮箱是 user@example.com 的订阅者。
say.note: Claude 会调用列表工具并过滤该邮箱。

say.text: 给订阅者 ID 3887204736 打上标签 ID 123。
say.note: Claude 会执行打标签操作。

say.text: 取消订阅 ID 3887204736 的订阅者。
say.note: Claude 会执行取消订阅操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage ConvertKit (Kit) subscribers, tags, broadcasts, and broadcast stats. It first searches for available tools, then performs actions like listing subscribers, tagging, unsubscribing, viewing or deleting broadcasts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to view or manage ConvertKit subscribers, tags, or broadcasts. For example: find a subscriber, tag someone, unsubscribe, list or delete broadcasts.

say_en.text: Find the subscriber with email user@example.com.
say_en.note: Claude will call the list tool with that email filter.

say_en.text: Tag subscriber ID 3887204736 with tag ID 123.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the tagging operation.
Claude will perform the unsubscribe action.
